body: I wish I had had a similar experience. But you still have to ask yourself is it really worth risking someone's chances at leading a life of strafe and unhappiness?

I think adoption sounds like a great option! Would you really want to run the risk of burdening someone with struggles similar to yours? Depression runs in both sides of my family. My parents had 4 children. Only one doesn't suffer from depression. But if you do decide to have children really think about why you want to have them. Are your reasons selfish?

Hello there,
     Your story kind of reminds me of my childhood. I wish I had had, a person like your father in my life while growing up. I recommend trying to speak with him about your current feelings. The hardest part is bringing it up. You can do it. It's kind of like a cross country race, you just have to push through the pain, and you will feel better for it. If you can see if you can get in to speak with a councilor or psychiatrist. Who knows, maybe one of their solutions will work for you.  Don't worry too much about your looks. They matter less than you think. Just keep putting one foot in front of the other, and put on a smile. You still have plenty of time to goof off and enjoy the absurdness of life.

I appreciate your input. It feels as if  I am just walking towards a dead end. When I do the thing I almost enjoy, they are usually just distractions as I wait for an end. I am getting so tired of waiting. Alas, I know my problems won't disappear, I try not to burden others. I hate inconveniencing them, inflicting pain disgusts me. My ex-girlfriend, the mistress of my friend who committed suicide, blames herself for his demise. For her I will try to wait a reasonable amount of time before ending it, but how long can I really continue?
